description: The warehouse team has just completed a physical inventory count for three product lines and discovered that the system quantities do not match the physical counts. The results of the physical count have been saved to the file /home/ga/Desktop/physical_count.txt on the desktop. Log into Odoo (admin@example.com / admin, database: odoo_demo), navigate to the Inventory module and perform a physical inventory adjustment to reconcile the system quantities with the actual physical counts listed in that file. After completing the adjustment, create automatic reordering rules for each of the three products with the following parameters: minimum quantity = 15 units, maximum quantity = 60 units.
